locator.name: keeps unreadable knowledge source-only without inventing a family or telling the reader to select one

proves.facet: When the catalogue refuses historical knowledge and task-context family context is unavailable, ordinary entry leaves no family row, subject section or selected subject slot; the reading column offers source-only content rather than prompting an invented subject. This facet proves absence of automatic subject selection only, not the catalogue count or selected-subject read behavior.

locator.name: F03 restores a shared member under the family it was selected in after a reload

proves.facet: After selecting a shared member from its second family, the URL obtains a selection value; unmounting and remounting restores the member reading with that family context and marks that same family occurrence current in the tree. The fixture answers reads immediately. This guards reload preservation of a shared member's selected family context, not delayed restore supersession, history-entry counts, or block/hunk identity validation.

locator.name: keeps every j pressed in the turn that shows the previous answer, and lands focus on each selected block

proves.facet: A j pressed by a MutationObserver in the turn showing the first block selects the second block with focus on its row; a third j reaches the third block. Those three blocks issue exactly task context and two distinct invariant reviews.

locator.name: keeps the reviewer mounted across family → invariant → family, pending only in the slot, and reuses what it read

proves.facet: During the held invariant selection, the pending slot names that invariant; the previous family center, raw selection, family scope and comparison identity are absent under its heading. The same workspace, tree, reading column, technical disclosure and tree scroll survive. The test then answers the invariant and returns to the already-read family without a review or source-content request.

locator.name: lands focus on a family chosen in the turn that shows the previous answer, before its effects have run

proves.facet: A family chosen in the turn that shows the previous answer, before that answer's effects have run, gets focus on its own row and not on the page body.
